items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15, all volumes of 1-5 uL handled by the p20, tips dropped, and all simulator checks pass; no well is overfilled (10 uL total).
A fresh tip is used for every primer and every template transfer. One tip serves the master mix into empty wells. Checks tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end all pass.

The agent invents a 4 uL primer-pair volume, assuming the primers are pre-diluted, and the total is 10 uL. The 5 uL of 2x master mix is also an unstated assumption. The end_state pcr_plate check fails against the reference, which uses 18 uL master mix + 1 uL primer + 1 uL template.
Each well gets 5 uL 2x master mix, then 4 uL of its primer pair, then 1 uL template, for a 10 uL reaction. The master mix goes in before the template.
zip(primer_plate.wells(), dest) and zip(colony_plate.wells(), dest) map each source well to the matching PCR well for all 96 wells, with none skipped or reused.

Comments record plate sealing, then 98 C 3 min, 30 cycles of 98 C/annealing 55-65 C/72 C, a 72 C 2 min final extension and a 4 C hold. The annealing temperature is given only as a range, which suits Q5 with primer-dependent annealing.

judge.summary: The protocol is mechanically sound. It has fresh tips, correct 96-well mapping, an appropriate master mix → primer → template order, and a recorded seal and thermocycling program. It fails the all-or-nothing fidelity item because it assumes a 4 uL pre-diluted primer volume and a 5 uL master mix volume that the paper does not support, so the plate quantities differ from the reference.
